title: L'Oreal USA settles suit with four plaintiffs over hair straightening products
summary: L'Oreal has reached a settlement with four women who sued the US branch of the French cosmetics giant claiming that a hair straightening product caused their cancer. Danielle Ward Mason, an attorney for the plaintiffs, announced the agreement reached on Monday, November 16, but did not disclose the amount of the settlement, which came as the case was going to trial in Chicago.
